say:1:1530719001:1.text: Don't bother hiding it. I know you were the one who gave us wheat.
say:1:1530719001:1.source_cn: 错不了，当年就是你留下了麦田。
say:1:1530719001:1.male: Don't bother hiding it. I know you were the one who gave us wheat.
say:1:1530719001:1.female: Don't bother hiding it. I know you were the one who gave us wheat.

say:2:1530719002:1.text: Thanks to the wheat field, we've had enough food these years...
say:2:1530719002:1.source_cn: 这些年全靠着麦田，食物才没短缺的太过严重……
say:2:1530719002:1.male: Thanks to the wheat field, we've had enough food these years...
say:2:1530719002:1.female: Thanks to the wheat field, we've had enough food these years...
